p3a_pairs.what_would_make_this_wrong: If STEP-TRACE-B7 (S1482) elsewhere explicitly argues the Step-201 freeze and the pre-183 orphan-invariant-registry problem share a common root cause (e.g. both stem from the same supersession-discipline failure), rather than merely being co-catalogued findings, this should be upgraded toward a genuine relationship (likely still short of a clean enum value, since 'shared root cause' is not itself one of the 11).
